nodes.name: sw-north-acc-01
nodes.description:
Access switch 01, North campus. Layer-2 only: the ports are untagged access
ports, and the switch's own management address lives on the Vlan99 SVI
rather than on a port (NG-V009).

nodes.name: sw-north-acc-02
nodes.description: Access switch 02, North campus - second floor riser.

nodes.name: sw-north-acc-03
nodes.description: Access switch 03, North campus - third floor riser.

interfaces.name: TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
interfaces.description: Fibre trunk uplink to the distribution layer

nodes.name: rtr-north-core-01
nodes.description:
Layer-3 core router for the North campus. It routes between the campus VLANs
(whose gateways sit on sw-north-dist-01) and carries the two backbone
fibres of the inter-site ring.

interfaces.name: lo0
interfaces.description: Router ID, IGP and management target

nodes.name: sw-north-dist-01
nodes.description:
Distribution switch for the North campus. It aggregates the access-layer
trunks, hosts the SVI gateway for every campus VLAN, and reaches the core
router over a routed (untagged) fibre uplink.

interfaces.name: br0
interfaces.description: Switching instance carrying the access-layer trunks

interfaces.name: Ethernet52/1
interfaces.description:
Routed fibre uplink to rtr-north-core-01. No 'vlan' block: this port
is a layer-3 interface, not a bridge port.

notes.text:
The backbone is **single-mode fibre**: 4.2 km between sites, which is
past what copper does at any speed.

- `os2`, LC, 10Gbps
- the ring survives one break
